critical_code_review_comments: progress_pdf.py: owner-only query ({created_by: user.user_id} for court codes, {professional_created_by: user.user_id} for joint cases) correctly returns 404 for non-owners; verified via automated test with parent2 token.
progress_pdf.py: PDF is one page, status-only — no answer/score fields rendered. Closing boilerplate 'SA CoParents never shares a parent's answers.' is in every PDF.

completion_alerts.check_and_alert uses atomic $setOnInsert upsert on (user_id, ref) then checks claim.upserted_id — correctly enforces 'once per parent per case' even under concurrent saves. If email send fails, the doc is still marked 'failed' which still blocks re-send; this matches the spec ('status failed still proves the hook fired').

completion_alerts._sources filters Align-made codes with `created_by: {$nin: [None, ''}` AND requires `professional_created_by: {$nin: [None, '']}` on joint cases — Align codes correctly skipped (no professional email path).
completion_alerts.schedule_completion_check uses asyncio.create_task + strong ref set to avoid GC — safe fire-and-forget pattern.

court_checklist PUT /reminders accepts a Pydantic body (missing `enabled` -> 422 as required). The server upserts `reminders_off = not enabled`, so sending enabled:true after an email-unsubscribe (reminders_off=True) correctly flips it back to False — verified live.
Secret handling: INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET read via python-dotenv in /app/backend/.env; test file explicitly does not reference nor print the value. ✔
